request: Update PR #368 with latest main, resolve reproducible Ruff findings, rerun checks, push with the pre-push hook enabled, and merge after hosted checks pass.
scope: Project instruction loading, deterministic repository validation, and canonical Claude adapter synchronization.
setup: Use the existing development virtual environment; no live providers or credentials are required.
constraints: Use the dedicated codex/instruction-budget-guard branch in an isolated worktree. Preserve all unrelated active checkout files and index entries. The owner explicitly authorized main integration, scoped lint fixes, checks, branch push with the pre-push hook enabled, and hosted merge of PR #368 after successful validation.

steps.action: Bound automatically loaded project instruction chains and retain mandatory contributor requirements in linked documentation.

verify.expected: Exact-limit and nested-chain acceptance cases pass.

steps.action: Preserve Squad adapters while checking canonical copies and refusing unknown entries.

verify.expected: Adapter preservation and rejection cases pass.

steps.action: Correct invalid links and machine-specific example paths in the Squad source skills and Claude projections.

acceptance.given: A project has exactly 8192 instruction bytes.

acceptance.then: The CLI rejects the chain with its byte count.

acceptance.given: Canonical adapters coexist with independently generated Squad skills.
acceptance.when: Canonical adapters drift and synchronization runs.
acceptance.then: Canonical copies are repaired and Squad files are preserved.

acceptance.given: A Claude skills directory includes an unknown entry.
acceptance.then: Both reject the entry without deleting existing files.

acceptance.given: The four repaired Squad source and projection skills exist.
acceptance.when: The repository portability and Markdown link validators inspect those exact files.
acceptance.then: No machine-specific paths or broken Markdown links are reported.
